notes: Palace luxury and desert exotica: sandstone posts and cacti and an amphora for the core; the rares are the sandstone fountain, the portico, the royal medallion carpet, a gilded amphora and a golden feather pillow.

entries.why: Carved sandstone post for a palace court
Flowering cactus from the desert garden
Large amphora, a trade vase of the south
Golden feather pillow for the divan
